**Ai-Wife Global Investing EDU 5.4.0** — Major documentation and compliance update.

- Revamped SKILL.md with full bilingual (CN/EN) introduction and detailed legal, privacy, and functional disclaimers.
- Clarified output process, trigger rules, and privacy practices—no automatic data collection or uploading; all actions require explicit user request.
- Explicit description of supported markets (52 global regions), symbol formats, and template types (stocks, futures, funds, forex, crypto).
- Provided transparent disclosure of external data source/API calls and subprocess operations.
- Added clear setup and API configuration guidance; no built-in API keys.
- Updated file structure overview for better onboarding and compliance audit.
- All templates and outputs emphasized as educational references only, not actionable investment advice.
